results.note: Direct diff of ingest-medium.yml against ingest.yml confirms identical structure: same trigger shape (schedule/workflow_dispatch/push paths), permissions: contents: read, timeout-minutes: 10, checkout/setup-python/setup-uv steps, and `uv run python -m ingest.heartbeat --tier <tier>` pattern — only cron string ('37 */8 * * *' vs '17 0 * * *'), job name, and heartbeat secret name differ.

Confirmed pipeline.py:364 still contains the unmodified US-1201 filter `definition.expected_update_interval_seconds == TIER_INTERVAL_SECONDS[tier]`. The diff adds zero lines to pipeline.py/registry.py; ingest-medium.yml only invokes the existing `--tier medium` CLI option, reusing the filter rather than reimplementing it.

Research doc line 20 explicitly cites Healthchecks.io's own docs on 'one check per job' with a link (https://healthchecks.io/docs/configuring_checks/). Implementation matches it with a dedicated HEALTHCHECK_URL_INGEST_MEDIUM secret (ingest-medium.yml:28) distinct from the daily/canary checks, asserted by the workflow test.

Read the full test body: it calls heartbeat.main(['--tier','medium']) directly, mocking only I/O boundaries (psycopg.connect, httpx.get, and each vendor fetcher — with non-funding fetchers set to raise if called), then asserts the real pipeline persisted exactly the 4 medium funding-rate rows for BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB and pinged once. This genuinely drives the assembled system through its real entry point, matching the accepted daily-tier pattern.

Attempt 3's only new contribution toward C5 is this file, which documents a FAILED dispatch attempt (`gh workflow run` exited 1 with a sandbox network error, dial tcp forbidden) — not an actual completed or dispatched GitHub Actions run. No run URL, no conclusion, nothing in events.ndjson/SESSION.md showing ingest-medium.yml ever executed on GitHub's infrastructure. This is the same structural gap already closed for US-1202-C5 only by a human manually running `gh workflow run` outside the sandbox and citing the resulting run URL — that remediation has not happened here.
Gate result 'US-1203-C6: exit 0 [uv run pytest -q]' confirms the full offline suite (297 passed, 29 deselected) is green on current HEAD, including the new medium-tier tests.

note: 5/6 criteria are genuinely met on current HEAD (3720c58): C1-C4 and C6 all have concrete, verified evidence in the repo. C5 remains unmet — attempt 3 added only a text file recording a failed local dispatch attempt due to sandbox network restrictions, not proof of a real GitHub Actions run of ingest-medium.yml. This is the identical unresolved gap flagged in the story's own prior verifier passes (attempts 1 and 2), and unlike US-1202 it has not been closed by an out-of-band human dispatch with a cited run URL.
